show.description: Determined to investigate poor reviews of his family's luxury cruise line, billionaire CEO Aditya Rathod goes undercover as a lowly steward, only to endure relentless abuse from classist employees and a heartbreaking betrayal by his long-term girlfriend—ultimately finding true love and justice with a spirited supervisor who valued his character long before she knew his net worth.
